tools.name: list_tracking
tools.description: List your tracked accounts with profile counts and snapshot times. Reads stored data without collection charges.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read stored profile information and follower/following counts. Counts may have a different observation time than lists. No online collection.

tools.name: list_followers
tools.description: Read a page of the most recent accessible follower snapshot, or permitted public query cache. State its asOf and partial coverage. Never collects automatically.

tools.name: list_following
tools.description: Read a page of the most recent accessible following snapshot, or permitted public query cache. State its asOf and partial coverage. Never collects automatically.

tools.name: get_account_changes
tools.description: Read detected changes in your accessible tracking history, default last seven calendar days UTC. detectedAt is detection time, not exact Instagram action time. For the next page send username and cursor; the cursor keeps the list, dates and timezone.

tools.name: query_public_account
tools.description: Explicit online query of a public profile or ONE page of followers/following (one source page, usually 25 people). May consume credits: a first list page needs maxCredits of at least 2 (profile + page), a next page 1. Require user authorization for this target, type and maxCredits. Generate and keep

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "query_public_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
